info.title: Monet Controller API
info.description: Local Hono controller API for the Monet desktop application.

tags.name: Providers
tags.description: Provider, model catalog, and validation endpoints.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: Run lifecycle endpoints such as interruption.

description.example: Reads a UTF-8 text file from an authorized directory.

get.description: Returns a readiness payload for local controller orchestration.

post.description: Requests interruption of an in-flight run and marks unfinished persisted state as interrupted.

404.description: The requested run was not found.

500.description: The run could not be stopped.

get.description: Returns persisted sessions ordered by recent activity.

post.description: Creates a blank session with optional provider and model defaults.

400.description: Request body or provider/model selection is invalid.

422.description: The requested provider could not resolve a model.

500.description: The session could not be created.

get.description: Returns a single session and its persisted message history.

404.description: The requested session was not found.

500.description: The session detail could not be loaded.

patch.description: Updates mutable session fields such as the title.

404.description: The requested session was not found.

500.description: The session could not be updated.

delete.description: Deletes a session and recursively removes its session workspace.

404.description: The requested session was not found.

500.description: The session could not be deleted.

post.description: Marks a session as archived without deleting its history.

404.description: The requested session was not found.

500.description: The session could not be archived.

post.description: Validates the session, derives its workspace path server-side, and ensures the workspace directory exists before desktop opening.

200.description: Session workspace directory is ready to open.

404.description: The requested session was not found.

500.description: The session workspace directory could not be prepared.

get.description: Returns persisted providers ordered by enabled status and name.

500.description: The provider could not be created.

patch.description: Updates provider metadata such as API proxy URL and timeout.

500.description: The provider could not be updated.

delete.description: Deletes a provider record and its models.

409.description: The provider cannot be deleted due to associated runs.

500.description: The provider could not be deleted.

get.description: Returns all persisted provider models ordered by enabled status and provider.
Returns persisted models for a single provider.

404.description: The requested provider was not found.

500.description: The provider models could not be loaded.

500.description: The provider model could not be created.

404.description: The requested provider was not found.

500.description: The provider model could not be created.

post.description: Fetches the external provider model catalog, persists it, and returns the updated persisted models.

404.description: The requested provider was not found.

500.description: The provider catalog could not be fetched.

post.description: Validates a persisted provider against current local configuration and enabled models.

get.description: Returns whether a provider credential is available without exposing the credential value.

put.description: Updates the running controller's in-memory credential for a provider without returning the credential value.

delete.description: Clears the running controller's in-memory credential for a provider. Environment credentials, if present, remain effective.

get.description: Returns the persisted allowlist of authorized directories used by filesystem tools.

put.description: Replaces the persisted allowlist of authorized directories used by filesystem tools.

get.description: Returns tools available from the in-process controller tool registry.
